verdict.rationale: Claude Design can 'apply your team's design system to every project automatically' and offers sliders to tune spacing/color, and one community report describes it building 'reusable PenPot components and design system tokens' via an MCP export flow — but there's no first-party evidence of native token/variable definitions with mode/theme switching (light/dark, brand variants) inside Claude Design itself. missing for 10: explicit token/variable editor, multi-mode/theme support, first-party documentation of applying themes across multiple designs.
